title: 1988 Fleer Baseball Card Chuck Crim Rookie Milwaukee Brewers #162
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 1988 Fleer Baseball Card featuring Chuck Crim, a rookie player for the Milwaukee Brewers. This vintage sports trading card measures 3½" x 2½" and is an original release by Fleer. It is part of the Fleer Baseball Card set and is branded with the card number 162. The card represents Chuck Crim as a member of the baseball franchise from the 1988 season. This collectible piece is perfect for fans of baseball and sports trading cards looking to add a piece of memorabilia from the past to their collection.
